title: Exponential time bound
statement:
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, with $k$ work tapes and state set $Q$, and let $C,c_0,n,S$ be natural numbers satisfying $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1\le S$. Set $H=3(|Q|+1)$ and $K=2(H+3k+1)+2$. For $m\in\mathbb N$, define $h(0)=0$, $h(m)=\lfloor\log_2 m\rfloor+1$ when $m>0$, and $g(m)=1+h(m)$; set $b(m,s)=2^{K(s+g(m)+1)}$ and $B(m,t)=3b(m,t+1)+m+3$. Then
\[
2^{C(\lfloor\log_2(B(n,c_0S)+1)\rfloor+1+\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+2)}\bigl(3b(n,c_0S+1)+1\bigr)^2
\le 2^{\left((C(K(c_0+3)+4)+2K(c_0+3)+4)(S+1)\right)}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet
